subject: South Street Historic District Proposal
overview: The commission reviewed historical research on South Street properties to consider creating local historic district protections. Lacking a quorum, no formal votes were taken, and commissioners agreed to prepare proposed boundary maps and a community outreach plan ahead of their December meeting.

items.title: 253 South Street Porch Application
items.summary: Chair Christopher Bader noted that the applicant had withdrawn the application for a porch prior to the meeting.

items.title: South Street Historic District Discussion
items.summary: Libby Brown presented research detailing pre-1855 homes and maritime history in the South Street neighborhood, after which the commission discussed whether to pursue single-house districts or a broader contiguous boundary and assigned members to draft boundary options and an outreach plan for the next meeting.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: The floor was opened for public comment, and none was received.
